profile.headline: Software Engineer at Pinterest
profile.summary:
Software Engineer who enjoys tackling new issues by finding innovative solutions. Love collaborating in teams to accomplish and outperform a shared objective while being creative. I wish to apply my problem-solving ingenuity to address real-world problems and manifest a more convenient and connected world through my passion for technology. 

Want to stay in touch?
Email me at: mreyeszaz@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Engineered a dynamic map overlay utilizing custom SVG pushpins, integrated with the Bing Maps React component
• Contributed to both frontend and backend solutions utilizing the Bing Maps API for the Family Safety web application,
facilitating real-time family location tracking, impacting 19.6 million monthly users
• Designed robust React components to handle cold, warm and error states; authored unit tests for all components

positions.title: Computer Science Instructor
positions.description:
• Lead weekly classes using Python and C++ to multiple students ages 8-18. 
• Collaborate with students as they design and build their projects using concepts developed over the course of the 6 month curriculum.

positions.title: Futureforce Hackathon Participant
positions.description:
• Participated in a 3 day virtual hackathon hosted by Salesforce where I collaborated in a team of 3 to develop a platform called Pathways
• The goal of Pathways is to address the lack of diversity within the tech industry. Pathways takes scholarships, internships and full-time roles for diverse students, and categorizes these opportunities for ease of access

honors.title: 3rd Place at SHPE 2020 Innovation Challenge Hackathon
honors.description: Collaborated in a team of 4 where we created a blockchain tracking app for retail food products called Traceability. Contributed in planning, designing, and creating the prototype for the app that traced food products back to their origin. Team placed 3rd in the SHPE Innovation Challenge.
honors.issuer: Issued by Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers · Oct 2020

honors.title: Seal of Biliteracy
honors.description: The Seal of Biliteracy is an award granted by a school, district, organization or state in the United States of America, in recognition of students who have studied and attained proficiency in two or more languages by high school graduation.
honors.issuer: Issued by California Department of Education · Jun 2018

projects.title: Shakespeare Text Analyzer
projects.description:
• Used Qt toolkit to create a C++ desktop application that analyzes words used by William Shakespeare
• Application runs in Windows 10 and Mac OS to support portability
• Designed data structure that reads and organizes text, lowering the execution time by 80 percent

organizations.name: Code2040
organizations.description: The Fellows Program is an intensive career accelerator for Black and Latinx college and graduate-level computer science students. For 9 weeks between June and August, you’ll intern at a top tech company and engage in racial equity advocacy work.

organizations.name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
organizations.description: SHPE changes lives by empowering the Hispanic community to realize its fullest potential and to impact the world through STEM awareness, access, support and development.
